web.title: ▷ Company - Euromed Group - leading manufacturer of premium-quality botanical extracts | Euromed
web.description:
Founded in 1971 by the German phytopharmaceutical company Madaus and now part of the Dermapharm Group, Euromed is a vertically integrated and GMP-certified leading manufacturer of gold-standard standardized botanical extracts and botanical active ingredients for the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food, pet care and cosmetic industries.
Manufacturers of the 1st standardized Milk Thistle extract for use in the world’s leading registered phytomedicinal product in 1971, being today the main worldwide expert and producer of standardized Milk Thistle.
1973
Euromed expanded into the phytopharmaceutical industry.
Nowadays our Mediterranean fruit and vegetable extracts are manufactured in an environmentally friendly manner in this state-of-the-art water-based extraction facility.
2018
Inauguration of Euromed’s innovation and research facility with technologically advanced laboratory in Mollet del Vallès, Barcelona, Spain, in 2018.
A strong focus on science is the key to innovation at Euromed.
2019 and onwards
Now Euromed is part of the German pharmaceutical Dermapharm Holding SE
